subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should this be fixed now as a cron/session cleanup active-admission guard, or folded into the broader cron retention and session/transcript storage migration path?
rationale: The bug is source-backed, but the durable repair boundary crosses cron retention, active session-work admissions, destructive transcript archival, and the database-first storage migration direction.

options.title: Add Active-Admission Guard Now
options.body: Teach the cron reaper to skip or drain active admitted run identities before removing entries or archiving transcripts, and keep broader retention/storage cleanup on their existing trackers.

options.title: Fold Into Storage/Retention Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as a blocker for the cron retention and SQLite flip work, accepting that the active-run failure remains unresolved until that larger path lands.

options.title: Relax Ambiguous Cleanup Temporarily
options.body: Disable or loosen destructive cron run cleanup when active state is ambiguous, reducing immediate risk at the cost of retaining stale session artifacts.

recommendation.title: Add Active-Admission Guard Now
recommendation.body: Teach the cron reaper to skip or drain active admitted run identities before removing entries or archiving transcripts, and keep broader retention/storage cleanup on their existing trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership across the session cleanup lifecycle seam and the active session/transcript storage migration tracker this decision must align with.
